title: ## Corrigendum to b742’s record (relay data/b742_events.txt rows (1)-(6) and data/b742_defects.txt): six events and nineteen defects, each CLAIM or CLOSE and NEW or REPEAT; the root prompt’s remote figures, the commit tool taking no subject text, the push tool’s pre-check, the hold and the hook as REPEAT, the dispatch’s targets and labels, the “=” file’s origin and the citation reader’s label, at tools/standing/ v1.23.0, each controlled, under (R353)(3)
notes: Dated note, b743, to event (6) (`(R353)`(3)(vi)): the zero-byte file “=” at the relay root was created and last written 2026-09-24T18:18:38Z, inside b511 (its act commit fc9f9e9d at 18:21:02Z). b511’s defect (e) (relay data/b511_defects.txt) records that its defects bank was first written through a double-quoted shell string whose backtick possessives the shell ran as command substitution; defect (d)’s words “VACUOUS where B >= |m|” stand inside such a backtick span, and the shell read the “>=” there as a redirect to a file named “=”. Reproduced in an empty directory, the same words in a double-quoted string make one empty file “=” (relay data/b743_standing_v1230.txt, the (origin) case). No session transcript of that window survives. Delete or leave is the author’s word at the sitting (`(R353)`(4)(G)).

Dated note, b743, to event (3) (`(R353)`(3)(i)): the clause “nothing past bce5605d pushed” came from the seat’s progress note, not from a remote read. Composed from the remote heads as they stood at prompt time it reads “relay remote at 13498fd2; local 25 commits past it; PLACE-papers remote at efce669f; local 1 commit past it” (the (remote) case). The author’s answer is carried as given.

Dated note, b743, to event (5) (`(R353)`(3)(iv)): the row is tagged THE HOST’S, NEW; the hold refused the part beneath 2560 MB and nothing ran, the class of b727 event (13), and this corrigendum reads it REPEAT in its counter.
